evidence: Read current server, discovery UI, playback coordinator/controller, NTS policy, triage, and read-only owner Omarchy NTS reference.
On 2026-11-13 a bounded NTS v2 search returned public episode metadata and SoundCloud audio_sources; two sampled Floating Points episodes had no progressive candidate with native yt-dlp selector.

One 2024 sampled episode resolved to signed AAC m3u8 on playback.media-streaming.soundcloud.cloud; manifest GET returned 200 and CORS *, sampled segment references stayed on that origin, and first segment HEAD returned 200, CORS *, audio/mp4. Signed query values were not retained.
Primary MCP Apps CSP guidance and hls.js/yt-dlp documentation establish candidate mechanics; no ChatGPT-host archive audio test occurred.
open_risks: Audible archive playback, MSE support, CSP and browser gesture behavior inside the ChatGPT host remain unverified.
NTS API is undocumented; SoundCloud signed-media origins/formats may change. Mixcloud in-app playback is outside this proposal pending separate evidence.
A control tool can only confirm pause after its mounted app receives a same-browser coordinator acknowledgement.
summary: Specified distinct country and NTS launch views on one canonical UI resource, discoverable natural-language prompts, bounded NTS archive metadata/search, a fixed-origin SoundCloud HLS experiment, archive controls/seek/retry, and same-browser acknowledged pause control. Shared resource and legacy aliases receive the exact archive CSP origin in both lists; signed URLs use only app-only _meta, with no model/persistence exposure. Production changes require exact revision approval.
